title: PLAENGYAO 35K Super Half Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2025 Race Was Like
seo_title: PLAENGYAO Super Half Marathon Review: 2025 Race, Results, Weather
meta_description: PLAENGYAO Super Half Marathon review from the 2025 race: a 33 km headline distance starting at 4am, overnight rain and 99% humidity, and how fast 1,361 timed finishers ran in Chachoengsao.
dek: What the Plaeng Yao club race in Chachoengsao was like in 2025, when its long race was 33 km: the early starts, a wet and saturated morning, what the entry included, and how fast each race ran.
verdict: Enter if you want a step between a half marathon and a marathon, run by a local club at a low price. In 2025 the 33 km was the main event, with 614 finishers, and started at 4am after overnight rain, in air at about 25°C and 98% humidity under full cloud. The 21 km and 10 km were smaller and ran at an easy club pace. The long race grew to 35 km for 2026. Little is published about the course or aid, so treat it as a friendly local race rather than a polished one.

sections.heading: The Race: A 33 km Headline and Three Shorter Runs
paragraphs: The 2025 race was organised by Run Yao, the Plaeng Yao running club, from the Wang Yen Subdistrict Municipality office in Plaeng Yao district, Chachoengsao [1]. It offered a 33 km super half marathon, a 21 km, a 10 km and a 5 km [2]. No course map was published for 2025. Timing mats on the 33 km sat at 13.5, 23 and 28.5 km, and on the 21 km at 11 and 16.5 km [6].

The timing data puts the starts at 4am for the 33 km, 4.45am for the 21 km and 5.30am for the 10 km [6]. No cut-offs were published; the slowest finishers took 5:56 in the 33 km and 3:54 in the 21 km [6].

sections.heading: The Weather: Wet Night, Saturated Morning
paragraphs: Open-Meteo's reanalysis for the grid point at Plaeng Yao shows about 6 mm of rain between 1am and 3am, then a dry start: at 4am it was about 25°C with a 24°C dew point, 98% humidity, almost no wind and full cloud [5]. It stayed near 24°C and 99% humidity until 6am, reached 26°C at 7am and 28°C at 8am, when light rain returned, and was still overcast at 29°C at 10am [5].
The cloud kept the sun off, but in air this wet sweat does not evaporate. The median 33 km runner finished at about 7.30am, before the worst of the warming.

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: The 33 km was the biggest race, with 614 finishers. The fastest ran 2:04:46, the median took 3:29:58 and the slowest 5:55:36 [6].

The 21 km had 257 finishers. It was won in 1:24:17 by a man and 1:45:33 by a woman, tenth place was 1:40:46, and the median was 2:15:43; 28% broke two hours, 71% broke 2:30, and 30% of finishers were women [6]. The 10 km had 490 finishers, won in 37:03, with a median of 1:10:10, 31% under an hour and 38% women [6].
Awards were by age group in the 33 km, 21 km and 10 km, and to the top ten men and women in the 5 km, with no prize money mentioned [2].

sections.heading: Entry and What You Got
paragraphs: Fees in 2025 were THB 850 early and THB 900 regular for the 33 km, THB 750 and 800 for the 21 km, THB 600 and 650 for the 10 km and THB 500 for the 5 km [3]. Every entry included a race shirt and medal; finisher shirts went to the 33 km and 21 km only, and a THB 1,200 VIP entry added a polo shirt [3].
For 2026 the long race was stretched to 35 km, at the same venue, with the date set for Sunday 25 October 2026 and the 35 km priced at THB 900 [4].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the Next Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want an unusual distance to bridge a half and a full marathon, at a low price, with a field that runs at a relaxed pace: half the 2025 long-race field took more than 3:30.
Think twice if you need a published course map, cut-offs and aid plan before you commit; none were published for 2025.
Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on the organiser's entry pages and posters, the full results and modelled weather data.

faqs.question: How long is the PLAENGYAO Super Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: Longer than a half. In 2025 the headline race was 33 km, alongside a 21 km, a 10 km and a 5 km, and it drew 614 finishers, more than any other distance. For the 25 October 2026 race the long distance was extended to 35 km at the same venue in Plaeng Yao.

faqs.question: How fast is the PLAENGYAO 33 km field?
faqs.answer: Relaxed. In 2025 the 33 km was won in 2:04:46, the median finisher took 3:29:58 and the slowest 5:55:36. In the 21 km, half the field finished after 2:15:43, 28% broke two hours and 71% broke 2:30. The 10 km median was 1:10:10.

faqs.question: What was the weather like at the PLAENGYAO race?
faqs.answer: Wet and humid. Modelled weather for Plaeng Yao shows about 6 mm of rain before the 4am start in 2025, then about 25°C and 98% humidity under full cloud. It reached 28°C by 8am, with light rain, and stayed overcast through the morning.

editorial_notes: Written 2026-11-06 about the 2025 edition (PLAENGYAO 33K Super Half Marathon, Sunday 12 October 2025), the only edition for which we hold results; the 2026 race (35 km, 25 October 2026) has no results on file. The 33 km results are not in our finish-time file, whose 'Half' is the separate 21 km race; the 33 km finisher count and its fastest, median and slowest times were taken from the same official SportStats results feed. Start times are derived from the timing data; no 2025 schedule or cut-offs were published. Weather is Open-Meteo modelled reanalysis for the grid point at Plaeng Yao, not a station observation. No course map, aid plan, news report or runner account was found; the organiser's Facebook page could not be read. The entity's primary distance (21.1 km) understates the event, whose largest race is the long one. No rating.
